source_review.notes: Retrieved and reviewed all ten final destinations: PostgreSQL 18 EXPLAIN, join-order, planner, LATERAL, and REL_18_STABLE executor sources; current SQLite planning documentation; MySQL 8.4 nested-loop and BKA documentation; Graefe's primary survey; and CMU Fall 2023 join notes. Verified per-loop EXPLAIN interpretation, parameter propagation/rescan and matched-outer state, LATERAL evaluation, join-order constraints, memo/nestloop controls, join buffers/BKA, and cost-model framing. Historical, instructional, source-code, and current product claims are separately scoped.

evidence: Checked O, I, theta(o,i), tuple/page counts, M buffer pages, parameter bindings, fanout, match flags, materialization, memoization, batches, and loop metrics.
Checked bag occurrences, physical outer/inner roles, and logical preserved/null-supplying roles remain distinct.
Checked tuple, simple-page, block-page, and indexed-loop formulas define their variables and omitted factors.
notation_and_syntax.notes: TRUE match, UNKNOWN, no-match after exhaustion, and operational failure are not conflated.

evidence: Independently reproduced the finite inner bag with A/x and A/y multiplicity two, B/z multiplicity one, and the left null-extension for N.
Recomputed 16 tuple comparisons, three non-null outer probes, and two distinct non-null memo parameters.
Recomputed exercise models: 12,000,600 simple-page reads, 120,600 block-page reads with 100-page blocks, and 240,600 indexed outer-plus-probe touches.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Independent evidence is retained in artifacts/reviews/DBE-053/independent-recomputation.txt; page/touch totals are model quantities, not measured I/O.

evidence: Reviewed bag multiplication m times n for equal-valued outer and inner occurrences under TRUE qualification.
Derived block-loop cost BO + ceil(BO/(M-2)) BI from the number of retained outer blocks and one inner pass per block.
Reviewed indexed-loop cost as outer production plus the sum of probe and match/recheck cost over outer occurrences, with memo/batch reductions conditional on semantic validity.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The cost derivations explain mechanisms and do not claim universal latency rankings.

evidence: Reviewed empty sides, duplicate occurrences, NULL/UNKNOWN and null-safe variants, unmatched rows, many-to-many fanout, semi/anti early stop, and post-outer-join filters.
Reviewed tiny/huge/skewed outer inputs, repeated/unique composite parameters, cache thrash/huge entries, batching reorder, materialization spill, and parameter-sensitive indexes.

Reviewed collation/types, volatility/errors/effects, tenant/security/snapshot cache identity, concurrent versions/locks, DML recheck, cancellation, remote timeout/partial failure, retry, and schema evolution.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Timeout, exception, or cancellation cannot be interpreted as inner exhaustion or a successful empty result.

evidence: Checked each outer occurrence receives a complete current binding and fresh-equivalent inner evaluation without leaked cursor or parameter state.
Checked outer join match state is per occurrence; semi emits once on first TRUE; anti emits only after proven absence; all pairs preserve bag multiplicity.
Checked caching/batching preserves complete key identity, duplicate replay, visibility/residual/locking, association, order contracts, and cleanup.
invariant_checking.notes: Optimization may reuse work but must simulate the logical per-binding evaluation including required observable effects.

evidence: Reviewed the prefix invariant for inner join over prior outer occurrences and the current inner prefix.
Reviewed matched-state extensions for left outer, semi, and anti joins, including TRUE-only transitions and exhaustion requirements.
Reviewed simulation obligations for materialization, memoization, batching, ordered delivery, and parameterized rescans.
proof_review.notes: Implementation correctness for named engines and every concurrency/effect model remains outside the finite proof.

evidence: The executable explicitly labels finite bag/probe evidence and excludes SQL types/collations, MVCC, locks, effects, faults, limits, and real storage.
Simplified I/O formulas explicitly list cache, prefetch, output CPU, predicate, row-width, concurrency, and related omissions.
Current PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite behavior, the 1993 survey, and 2023 teaching material are cited according to their roles.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No finite output or asymptotic expression is presented as a universal optimizer or production-performance proof.

evidence: Repository verification passed one standard-library Python snippet with exact nine-line stdout, empty stderr, zero exit status, and recorded toolchain.
Independent recomputation reproduced bags, occurrence counts, probe/memo counts, page formulas, and all finite invariants.
All ten reference artifacts were retained under artifacts/references/DBE-053 and every repository-local link resolved.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No live DBMS join, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, index/page benchmark, memo/BKA implementation, MVCC/lock schedule, remote call, fault injection, or production workload was executed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed progression from bag/null join semantics through the iterator state machine, tuple/block/indexed cost, parameterization, materialization/memo/batching, outer/semi/anti correctness, ordering/startup, cardinality evidence, concurrency/failure, and verification.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed diagnosis with outer rows, inner rows per loop, loops/searches, fanout/skew, memo evidence, buffers/bytes, remote requests, waits, first/last-row latency, concurrency, locks, and result reconciliation. Controls are reversible and durable remedies target statistics, filtering, access paths, batching, locality, or decorrelation.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter derives four join kinds from first principles, connects proofs to executor state, uses a duplicate/null executable, supplies twelve misconceptions and ten distinct examples, and progresses through five exercises from exact tracing to multi-tier authorized top-N design with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary-source, source-code, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite or executor/optimizer maintainer, security, performance, reliability, operations, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and finite model prove neither universal nested-loop equivalence across every SQL type/collation/effect/join variant, correctness of any named implementation, cache/batch/memo validity in every snapshot/security setting, cardinality or cost accuracy, actual page/cache/parallel/remote performance, workload-independent algorithm choice, certification, nor deployment fitness.
